Self-posting and sharing happens all the time on the internet. And that's fine, but if you post to the wrong place, or at the wrong time, you usually go largely unnoticed. I wanted to make a space was not only safe for self-pomotion and sharing, but encouraged interaction between content creators. Somewhere you can get feedback on your video, or get help building an audience.

The biggest fear is that this would just boil into people throwing their posts up and nothing else (see reddit.com/r/gamereviews), and that doesn't help anybody. Especially because, the people you'd be posting to wouldn't be your audience to begin with.

So I want to also try and have a reason for non-creators to come here, either to find new content to consume, participate in conversation, or whatever.

Those are my goals :D But for now I'm going to spend some time dissecting the classes for this subverse, and try to build up a snazzy theme.

I have noticed a major increase in submissions being removed from v/news lately.

I would like to make a few suggestions.

  1. The v/news verse is not v/USNews or v/worldnews, and so it should not begin to restrict posts to either category. For those who want to post or read any kind of news, v/news is the logical choice. For those who want to limit or specialize their reading, they can go to the more specific verses.

  2. The requirement for recent news (#3) should be very specific so that it cannot be used as a tool for viewpoint censorship. I suggest one year.

  3. The requirement for submission titles (#4) should also be specific. How about use original titles and if desired, use a parenthetical for more information.

Examples from my history

Trumping the Federal Debt Without Playing the Default Card (aka a very simple and permanent solution to the national debt)

Somerville hangs Black Lives Matter banner at City Hall (Massachusetts)

CNN/ORC Poll: Trump tops in Iowa as Scott Walker drops ("The pundits were all wrong")

Until recently, very little has been removed from v/news and it has been working well. Let's please not rush to remove posts. A few questionable or even bad posts left up will not ruin the verse.

Ultimately, when complete, v/news rules should be

  1. as few as possible

  2. as neutral and non-debatable as possible

  3. as simple and workable for both users and mods as possible

Thank you all :)
